label: Claude Cowork — running task
description: A RUNNING Cowork task (built from actual screenshots): Home sidebar, main pane with the task title and Claude's SERIF prose streaming in (the claude.ai reading voice), 'Write a message…' composer with Manual mode + model picker + the 'Claude is AI…' disclaimer, and the RIGHT RAIL -- Progress card ('3 of 3' with optional step checklist), Outputs card (deliverables pop in), and Context card listing the CONNECTORS in play (Quotient via its real logo, Web Search, any others) that light up as the agent uses them. THE marketing-agent-at-work surface. SCRIPTED performable surface; camera anchors: transcript, input, panel (right rail), sidebar.

title.label: Task title in the header (e.g. 'Launch campaign plan')

history.label: Transcript at open: [{type: 'user'|'text'|'heading', text}] -- text renders in serif; heading is the bold serif section line

progress.label: {current, total} for the Progress card (e.g. {current: 1, total: 3})

progress_steps.label: Optional step checklist under Progress: [{text}] -- steps before `current` render checked

outputs.label: Outputs card rows at open: [{name: 'Campaign brief.md'}]

connectors.label: Context card connector chips: [{name, icon_url?, globe?, color?}]. Defaults to Quotient (real logo via logo.dev) + Web Search.

script.label: The task performance: type-message {text} + send-message (user bubble), working {text?} (orange ✳), stop-working, respond {text, heading?, duration?} (SERIF prose streams word by word; **bold** + `code`), claude-text {text, heading?}, tool-call {connector: 'Quotient', tool: 'create-campaign', label: 'Creating campaign in Quotient', params?: '{ name: "Free Trial Launch" }', result: 'Campaign created', duration?: 1.8} (THE tool-use beat: a tool row pops into the transcript with the connector's icon + spinner, the matching rail chip lights up automatically, then it flips to a green check with the result -- use REAL Quotient MCP tool names: create-campaign, create-social-post, create-blog, update-campaign, create-email...), set-progress {current, total?, steps?} (the Progress count ticks), add-output {name} (a deliverable row pops into Outputs), use-connector {name, duration?} (manually light a rail chip). NEVER move the camera from a script -- scene camera_moves with anchors (transcript, input, panel).

script_actions.description: Post the typed text as a user bubble
Stream serif Claude prose word by word

The REAL Cowork tool-use treatment: a muted group titled with the humanized tool name ('list-social-posts' -> 'List Social Posts') containing a vertical timeline -- optional clock-icon thinking text (with `code` chips), the tool row with the connector's icon and a 'Result' pill, an orange dotted 'Using Quotient…' spinner while running, then ✓ Done -- and the whole group AUTO-COLLAPSES to a one-liner with a chevron ('List Social Posts ›'). The matching rail chip lights up in sync.

params.connector: string - matches connectors[].name (icon + rail chip sync)
params.tool: string - real MCP tool name, e.g. list-social-posts, create-campaign, create-social-post
params.title: string - override the humanized group title
params.thinking: string - clock-icon reasoning line ('I already have the `list-social-posts` tool loaded with the `PUBLISHED` filter. Let me call it.')
params.collapse: boolean - auto-collapse to the one-liner (default true)
params.collapse_delay: number - seconds after done before collapsing (default 1.0)
params.keep_live: boolean - leave the rail chip lit

script_actions.description: Update the Progress card count (and optional step checklist)
A deliverable row pops into the Outputs card
A connector chip lights up while in use, then settles
